title: Hook C · Her outfit card (day HC)
imagePrompt: Photographed as a single frame from a US feature film, shot on an ARRI Alexa Mini LF in large format with an ARRI Signature Prime at 50mm and T4, the camera on a locked tripod at standing eye height, composed natively for a vertical 9:16 frame with no letterbox bars. An outfit reference card for one story day: Image 1 is the woman — copy her face, age, steel-grey blunt chin-length bob with its heavy straight fringe, and her small, slight, narrow-shouldered build exactly; take nothing of her clothing from Image 1. She stands full length, dead centre, facing the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, against a plain seamless mid-grey studio backdrop in soft even daylight from the left, the whole figure from hair to shoes inside the frame and filling about two-thirds of its height. She wears, and only these: a knee-length burgundy raincoat, belted and buttoned; slim black trousers; plain black trainers; a small black leather handbag on her right shoulder, hands free. Nothing else is worn or carried: no scarf, no hat, no gloves, no jewellery, no other bag. Across the bottom of the card, on a plain white strip below the figure, one caption line in small black sans-serif text: "HER · Day HC: burgundy raincoat, black trousers, black trainers, handbag on shoulder". Negatives: no other people, no props, no set, no logos on the clothing, no text other than the caption.
